name: coml-connector-3d
assumptions: Saved PCB dimensions and copper fills; supplier material values remain unconfirmed.
Connector pins are editable 0.5 mm square, 5 mm tall approximations; housing omitted.
PEC sheet copper; conductor loss is not predicted.
Uniform soldermask slabs; pad-window geometry is not extracted.
Connector through-holes have ideal PEC solder fill joining each contact to its barrel.
Three spot frequencies (1, 4 and 10 MHz); no fitted transient model, fast-edge bandwidth or interpolation accuracy is established.

Two half-ports terminate at actual transformer secondary pads using SC_CT only as an internal port reference. Equal half-port currents enforce zero external SC_CT current in the reduced differential network. SC_CT has no added physical ground connection.
Flux-error estimator tolerance is 1e-2 for bounded runtime; the field solve remains at 1e-8. Error indicators are approximate diagnostics, not a convergence qualification.
engineering_context: CMU-007 sections 2 and 4: bounded PCB communication routing and connector coupling; no full-link acceptance
